description: Cyclone Chido: Building Damage Assessment in Passamanty, Mayotte is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Microsoft AI for Good Lab. We ran our damage assessment AI models on images provided by Planet and have mapped out the affected buildings. The images cover Passamainty in Mayotte. Coverage: Mayotte. The portal files it under the publisher Microsoft AI for Good Lab. Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, damage assessment, geodata, natural disasters. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOPACKAGE. The portal shows 2025-01-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
